I suppose it does have a particular flair.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_D.cz: Myslím, že to má specifický šmrnc.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_D.original_cz: Myslím, že to má specifický šmrnc.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_D.en: Shall I take that as a compliment?
Perhaps, perhaps not.
The wearer is certainly powerful enough.
Some people here have so little in the way of manners.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_D.cz: Někteří lidé tady nemají moc slušného vychování.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_D.original_cz: Někteří lidé tady nemají moc slušného vychování.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_D.en: Are Villagers rude to you?
I think people are pretty polite!
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_D.cz: Myslím, že lidi jsou docela slušní!
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_D.original_cz: Myslím, že lidi jsou docela slušní!

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_D.en: Are manners really important?
Most of them, no. Though, I suspect that's because they fear me, as they should.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_D.cz: Většina z nich ne. I když mám podezření, že je to proto, že se mě bojí, což by měli.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_D.original_cz: Většina z nich ne. I když mám podezření, že je to proto, že se mě bojí, což by měli.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_D.en: Then your standards are far too low.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_D.cz: Pak jsou vaše standardy příliš nízké.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_D.original_cz: Pak jsou vaše standardy příliš nízké.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_D.en: Yes. I find rudeness quite unforgivable.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_D.cz: Ano. Hrubost považuji za naprosto neodpustitelnou.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_D.original_cz: Ano. Hrubost považuji za naprosto neodpustitelnou.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_D.en: It won't surprise you to learn that I'm rather partial to ravens.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_D.cz: Nebude tě překvapovat, když se dozvíš, že mám docela slabost pro havrany.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_D.original_cz: Nebude tě překvapovat, když se dozvíš, že mám docela slabost pro havrany.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_D.en: Ravens are great!
I like more colorful birds.
I don't like birds!
On this, we agree.
Oh? And which species in particular?
Pink flamingos.
Rainbow lorikeets!
Ruby-throated hummingbirds.
If they truly are pink, I doubt I would care for such a creature.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_D.cz: Pokud jsou opravdu růžové, pochybuji, že by se mi o takového tvora líbilo.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_D.original_cz: Pokud jsou opravdu růžové, pochybuji, že by se mi o takového tvora líbilo.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_D.en: Rainbow...?
No.
Red-throated, you say?
I'm intrigued.
On that we shall have to disagree.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_D.cz: V tom se budeme muset neshodnout.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_D.original_cz: V tom se budeme muset neshodnout.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_D.en: That depends.
Describe yourself.
I want the best outcome for everyone.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_D.cz: Chci pro všechny co nejlepší výsledek.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_D.original_cz: Chci pro všechny co nejlepší výsledek.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_D.en: You can't put me in a box.
This question makes me anxious!
A good fairy it is then.
Such a pity.
Refusal to be defined?
Magic is rarely neutral, {PlayerName}.
You'll likely find that you must choose if you're to achieve your full power.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_D.cz: Pravděpodobně zjistíte, že si musíte vybrat, pokud chcete dosáhnout své plné síly.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_D.original_cz: Pravděpodobně zjistíte, že si musíte vybrat, pokud chcete dosáhnout své plné síly.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_D.en: Ah.
Too human for either, I think.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_D.cz: Na obojí je to podle mě až příliš lidské.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_D.original_cz: Na obojí je to podle mě až příliš lidské.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_D.en: My castle. Is that not obvious?
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_D.cz: Můj hrad. Není to snad jasné?
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_D.original_cz: Můj hrad. Není to snad jasné?

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_D.en: And you?
The Bind.
Everafter.
Mythopia.
Why?
Books are my everything.
The owls are a hoot.
Fall is my favorite season.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_D.cz: Podzim je moje nejoblíbenější roční období.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_D.original_cz: Podzim je moje nejoblíbenější roční období.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_D.en: A seeker of knowledge. A quality I respect.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_D.cz: Hledající poznání. Vlastnost, kterou si vážím.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_D.original_cz: Hledající poznání. Vlastnost, kterou si vážím.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_D.en: Wise birds. Though, not as faithful as ravens.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_D.cz: Moudří ptáci. I když ne tak věrní jako havrani.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_D.original_cz: Moudří ptáci. I když ne tak věrní jako havrani.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_D.en: You have a favorite? How... quaint.
Do tell.
It's like walking in a fairy tale.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_D.cz: Je to jako procházka v pohádce.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_D.original_cz: Je to jako procházka v pohádce.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_D.en: I love the little dragons!
You live there, of course!
And where you come from, that is welcomed, I suppose.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_D.cz: A tam, odkud pocházíš, je to, předpokládám, vítáno.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_D.original_cz: A tam, odkud pocházíš, je to, předpokládám, vítáno.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_D.en: Charming, yes. Though not useful.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_D.cz: Okouzlující, ano. I když ne užitečné.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_D.original_cz: Okouzlující, ano. I když ne užitečné.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_D.en: Flattery? But is it genuine? Time shall tell.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_D.cz: Lichotky? Ale jsou opravdové? Čas ukáže.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_D.original_cz: Lichotky? Ale jsou opravdové? Čas ukáže.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_D.en: Explain yourself.
I'm a fan of myths!
The baby pegasi are so cute!
HADES RULES!
Yes, they can be quite illuminating.
How soft your heart is...
Well, aren't you the fool?
Why should I? My grievances are thoroughly justified.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_D.cz: Proč bych měl? Mé stížnosti jsou naprosto oprávněné.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_D.original_cz: Proč bych měl? Mé stížnosti jsou naprosto oprávněné.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_D.en: Forgiveness is healing.
It might feel good.
I'm not saying you SHOULD, just asking if you have.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_D.cz: Neříkám, že byste MĚL/A, jen se ptám, jestli ano.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_D.original_cz: Neříkám, že byste MĚL/A, jen se ptám, jestli ano.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_D.en: You presume I am injured. I am not, I assure you.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_D.cz: Předpokládáte, že jsem zraněný. Ujišťuji vás, že nejsem.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_D.original_cz: Předpokládáte, že jsem zraněný. Ujišťuji vás, že nejsem.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_D.en: I find indignation to be quite satisfying.
I believe you know the answer to that.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_D.cz: Věřím, že na to odpověď znáš.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_D.original_cz: Věřím, že na to odpověď znáš.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_D.en: I don't seem.
I AM quiet.
You could talk more; the Villagers are friendly!
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_D.cz: Mohli byste mluvit víc; vesničané jsou přátelští!
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_D.original_cz: Mohli byste mluvit víc; vesničané jsou přátelští!

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_D.en: Are you listening for something?
Is it because you're shy?
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_D.cz: Je to proto, že se stydíš?
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_D.original_cz: Je to proto, že se stydíš?

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_D.en: Perhaps. But I have no wish to hear anything they might say.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_D.cz: Možná. Ale nechci slyšet nic z toho, co by mohli říct.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_D.original_cz: Možná. Ale nechci slyšet nic z toho, co by mohli říct.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_D.en: Aw, that's no fun.
Seems a little anti-social.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_D.cz: Zdá se mi to trochu asociální.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_D.original_cz: Zdá se mi to trochu asociální.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_D.en: I have no wish to have "fun" either.
Society is vastly overvalued.
One hears many things, if one is wise enough to listen.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_D.cz: Člověk slyší mnoho věcí, pokud je dostatečně moudrý, aby naslouchal.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_D.original_cz: Člověk slyší mnoho věcí, pokud je dostatečně moudrý, aby naslouchal.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_D.en: Like singing birds?
Like enemy plots?
I prefer birds that caw and crow.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_D.cz: Mám raději ptáky, kteří krakají a kokrhají.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_D.original_cz: Mám raději ptáky, kteří krakají a kokrhají.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_D.en: Yes. Much is revealed when one's lips are sealed.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_D.cz: Ano. Když si člověk zapečetí ústa, hodně se odhalí.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_D.original_cz: Ano. Když si člověk zapečetí ústa, hodně se odhalí.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_D.en: Hardly. I choose solitude.
Relatable. I like to be alone.
Well if you ever choose to be a social butterfly, come to me!
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_D.cz: No, pokud se někdy rozhodneš být společenským motýlem, přijď ke mně!
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_D.original_cz: No, pokud se někdy rozhodneš být společenským motýlem, přijď ke mně!

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_D.en: Perhaps you should build your own castle, rather than a Village.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_D.cz: Možná by sis měl postavit vlastní hrad, spíše než vesnici.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_D.original_cz: Možná by sis měl postavit vlastní hrad, spíše než vesnici.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_D.en: That day shall never come. I assure you.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_D.cz: Ten den nikdy nepřijde, ujišťuji vás.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_D.original_cz: Ten den nikdy nepřijde, ujišťuji vás.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_G.en: A gift? You have my thanks.
Be brief, {PlayerName}. I have matters to attend to.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_G.cz: Buď stručný, {PlayerName}. Mám věci na práci.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_G.original_cz: Buď stručný, {PlayerName}. Mám věci na práci.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_G.en: I knew you would come to me, sooner or later.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_G.cz: Věděl jsem, že ke mně dříve nebo později přijdeš.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_G.original_cz: Věděl jsem, že ke mně dříve nebo později přijdeš.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_G.en: Happens every day! See you soon.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_G.cz: Děje se to každý den! Brzy se uvidíme.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_G.original_cz: Děje se to každý den! Brzy se uvidíme.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_G.en: I do find the darkness soothing.
Such grim weather. It's almost charming.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_G.cz: Takové ponuré počasí. Je to skoro okouzlující.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_G.original_cz: Takové ponuré počasí. Je to skoro okouzlující.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_G.cz: To otravné sluneční světlo ti vyhovuje.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_G.original_cz: To otravné sluneční světlo ti vyhovuje.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_G.en: Thank you! Talk to you soon.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_H.en: Seek me again if you have need of additional assistance.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_H.cz: Pokud budete potřebovat další pomoc, obraťte se na mě znovu.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_H.original_cz: Pokud budete potřebovat další pomoc, obraťte se na mě znovu.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_H.en: Farewell, until you seek me out again.
Our time has ended? Well then, farewell.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_H.cz: Náš čas skončil? Tak tedy sbohem.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_H.original_cz: Náš čas skončil? Tak tedy sbohem.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_H.en: I shall take my leave of you.
Far be it from me to refuse a gracious invitation.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_H.cz: Daleko ode mě, abych odmítl laskavé pozvání.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_H.original_cz: Daleko ode mě, abych odmítl laskavé pozvání.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: Hmm? What is this?
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Hmm? Co to je?
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Hmm? Co to je?

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: Some sort of enchanted piece of paper?
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Nějaký začarovaný kus papíru?
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Nějaký začarovaný kus papíru?

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: It's a piece of you, Maleficent.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Je to kousek tebe, Zlobe.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Je to kousek tebe, Zlobe.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: It holds an important moment from your life.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Obsahuje důležitý okamžik z vašeho života.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Obsahuje důležitý okamžik z vašeho života.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: Just look at it already! Tell me what you see!
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Už se na to podívej! Řekni mi, co vidíš!
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Už se na to podívej! Řekni mi, co vidíš!

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: A piece of me...?
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Kousek mě...?
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Kousek mě...?

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: Oh. How curious.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Ach. To je ale zvláštní.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Ach. To je ale zvláštní.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: I see the moment that I bestowed my gift upon Aurora.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Vidím ten okamžik, kdy jsem věnoval svůj dar Auroře.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Vidím ten okamžik, kdy jsem věnoval svůj dar Auroře.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: It was so simple, so ingenious. One prick from a spinning wheel before the sun set on her 16th birthday.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Bylo to tak jednoduché, tak geniální. Jeden píchnutí od kolovratu před západem slunce v den jejích šestnáctých narozenin.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Bylo to tak jednoduché, tak geniální. Jeden píchnutí od kolovratu před západem slunce v den jejích šestnáctých narozenin.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: That does have a malevolent elegance to it.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: To v sobě má zlomyslnou eleganci.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: To v sobě má zlomyslnou eleganci.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: That sounds pretty evil.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: To zní dost zlověstně.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: To zní dost zlověstně.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: It's an important part of your story... and Aurora's.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Je to důležitá součást tvého příběhu... a Aurořina.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Je to důležitá součást tvého příběhu... a Aurořina.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: Malevolent elegance. Oh, I like the sound of that.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Zlomyslná elegance. Ach, to zní líbí se mi.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Zlomyslná elegance. Ach, to zní líbí se mi.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: My... That's strange. Something's happening. The magic of the page... why, it's giving me strength.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: To je divné. Něco se děje. Kouzlo stránky... vždyť mi dává sílu.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: To je divné. Něco se děje. Kouzlo stránky... vždyť mi dává sílu.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: Ahh... Yes!
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Ááá... Ano!
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Ááá... Ano!

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: I can feel the curse's power over me waning.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Cítím, jak moc kletby nade mnou slábne.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Cítím, jak moc kletby nade mnou slábne.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: But I'm not free of it yet.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Ale ještě se toho nezbavil/a.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Ale ještě se toho nezbavil/a.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: The Quills told me there are two other <ActivityItem>Anchor Moments</ActivityItem> still being processed.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Brky mi řekly, že se stále zpracovávají dva další **Kotevní momenty**.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Brky mi řekly, že se stále zpracovávají dva další **Kotevní momenty**.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: Then you know what must be done.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Pak víš, co je třeba udělat.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Pak víš, co je třeba udělat.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: <Lore>Go and find them!</Lore>
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: <Lore>Jdi a najdi je!</Lore>
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: <Lore>Jdi a najdi je!</Lore>

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: Oh, I thought it was quite fair, after the slighting I'd received.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Myslel jsem, že je to docela fér, po tom pohrdání, kterého jsem se dočkal.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Myslel jsem, že je to docela fér, po tom pohrdání, kterého jsem se dočkal.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: Yes. The two of us, forever intertwined, regardless of will. Like a rose and its thorns.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Ano. My dva, navždy propletení, bez ohledu na vůli. Jako růže a její trny.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Ano. My dva, navždy propletení, bez ohledu na vůli. Jako růže a její trny.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: An important moment...? Whatever could it be...?
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Důležitý okamžik...? Ať už je to cokoli...?
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Důležitý okamžik...? Ať už je to cokoli...?

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: So impatient. Aren't I the one disappearing?
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Tak netrpělivý. Nejsem to já, kdo mizí?
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Tak netrpělivý. Nejsem to já, kdo mizí?

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: Blast! These <Lore>Magic Quills</Lore> are hopeless!
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Sakra! Tyhle **Kouzelné brky** jsou beznadějné!
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Sakra! Tyhle **Kouzelné brky** jsou beznadějné!

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: I'm being tormented by feathery fools.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Trápí mě opeření blázni.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Trápí mě opeření blázni.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: Go on. Speak to that feather-brained Quill and find out for yourself.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: No tak. Promluv si s tím tupým Quillem a zjisti to sám.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: No tak. Promluv si s tím tupým Quillem a zjisti to sám.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: They're ridiculous creatures.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Jsou to směšní tvorové.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Jsou to směšní tvorové.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: You're not actually going to wait five and a half billion years to speak to that Quill, are you?
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Nebudeš přece čekat pět a půl miliardy let, než si s tím Quillem promluvíš, že ne?
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Nebudeš přece čekat pět a půl miliardy let, než si s tím Quillem promluvíš, že ne?

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: I'm sure together we can think of a more expeditious solution.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Jsem si jistý, že společně dokážeme vymyslet rychlejší řešení.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Jsem si jistý, že společně dokážeme vymyslet rychlejší řešení.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: Have you found the pieces of my ticket yet?
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Už jsi našel kousky mého lístku?
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Už jsi našel kousky mého lístku?

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: They're scattered around here somewhere.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Jsou tu někde roztroušeni.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Jsou tu někde roztroušeni.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: Have you found my ticket?
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Našli jste můj lístek?
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Našli jste můj lístek?

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: When you do, change the number on the board to match it.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Když to uděláte, změňte číslo na tabuli tak, aby odpovídalo.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Když to uděláte, změňte číslo na tabuli tak, aby odpovídalo.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: The number on the ticket matches the number on the counter.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Číslo na lístku se shoduje s číslem na přepážce.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Číslo na lístku se shoduje s číslem na přepážce.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: Perhaps now these fools will spare a moment for you.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Možná si teď tihle blázni na tebe udělají chvilku.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Možná si teď tihle blázni na tebe udělají chvilku.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: Have you paid a visit to the next floor?
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Navštívil jsi už další patro?
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Navštívil jsi už další patro?

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: There must be some way to stop this blasted curse!
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Musí existovat nějaký způsob, jak zastavit tuhle zatracenou kletbu!
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Musí existovat nějaký způsob, jak zastavit tuhle zatracenou kletbu!

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: Well? What are you waiting for? Step through that portal and fix this!
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Tak co? Na co ještě čekáš? Projdi tím portálem a oprav to!
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Tak co? Na co ještě čekáš? Projdi tím portálem a oprav to!

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: The processing room must hold the answer we seek.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Zpracovatelská místnost musí obsahovat odpověď, kterou hledáme.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Zpracovatelská místnost musí obsahovat odpověď, kterou hledáme.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: Have you rectified this tediousness yet?
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Už jsi tuhle nudu napravil/a?
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Už jsi tuhle nudu napravil/a?

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: Hit that wheel near the Quill with your Royal Net. Don't waste more of my time.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Prašti to kolo u Brku svou Královskou sítí. Už mi neztrácej čas.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Prašti to kolo u Brku svou Královskou sítí. Už mi neztrácej čas.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: These petty, officious little fools.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Tito malicherní, úslužní malí blázni.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Tito malicherní, úslužní malí blázni.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: They have no idea whose wrath they're courting.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Nemají tušení, čí hněv si tím vyvolávají.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Nemají tušení, čí hněv si tím vyvolávají.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: I really ought to destroy this whole endeavor and turn this dungeon into their tombs!
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Opravdu bych měl zničit celé tohle úsilí a proměnit tohle kobku v jejich hrobky!
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Opravdu bych měl zničit celé tohle úsilí a proměnit tohle kobku v jejich hrobky!

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: *wait silently*
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: *tiše čeká*
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: *tiše čeká*

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: Maleficent! I'm here to rescue you!
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Zlobe! Jsem tu, abych tě zachránila!
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Zlobe! Jsem tu, abych tě zachránila!

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: Has anyone ever told you that you're a little extra?
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Řekl ti už někdo, že jsi trochu navíc?
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Řekl ti už někdo, že jsi trochu navíc?

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: Hm? Oh. It's you.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Hm? Aha. To jsi ty.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Hm? Aha. To jsi ty.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: The brave creature who trespassed in my castle and lived to tell of it.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Statečný tvor, který vnikl do mého hradu a přežil, aby o tom mohl vyprávět.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Statečný tvor, který vnikl do mého hradu a přežil, aby o tom mohl vyprávět.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: For a moment I thought you were another of those irritating <Lore>Magic Quills</Lore>.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Na chvíli jsem si myslel, že jsi další z těch otravných <Lore>Kouzelných brků</Lore>.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Na chvíli jsem si myslel, že jsi další z těch otravných <Lore>Kouzelných brků</Lore>.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: What is this place? How did you get here?
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Co je tohle za místo? Jak ses sem dostal/a?
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Co je tohle za místo? Jak ses sem dostal/a?

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: What are those Magic Quill things?
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Co jsou to za Magické brky?
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Co jsou to za Magické brky?

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: Why can't you just magic your way out of here?
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Proč se odsud prostě nemůžeš kouzlem dostat ven?
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Proč se odsud prostě nemůžeš kouzlem dostat ven?

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: Tell me what you need me to do.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Řekni mi, co potřebuješ, abych udělal/a.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Řekni mi, co potřebuješ, abych udělal/a.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: It pains me to say I don't know the answer to either question. This horrid place feels like some sort of dungeon created merely to vex me.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Bolí mě říct, že neznám odpověď na ani jednu otázku. Tohle hrozné místo mi připadá jako nějaký žalář stvořený jen proto, aby mě otravoval.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Bolí mě říct, že neznám odpověď na ani jednu otázku. Tohle hrozné místo mi připadá jako nějaký žalář stvořený jen proto, aby mě otravoval.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: When I arrived, one of those irksome <Lore>Magic Quills</Lore> floated over and informed me that I've been filed away to be erased.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Když jsem dorazil, jeden z těch otravných <Lore>Kouzelných brků</Lore> se vznášel nade mnou a informoval mě, že jsem byl zařazen do archivu k vymazání.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Když jsem dorazil, jeden z těch otravných <Lore>Kouzelných brků</Lore> se vznášel nade mnou a informoval mě, že jsem byl zařazen do archivu k vymazání.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: Can you imagine? Me?! Erased?
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Dokážeš si to představit? Já?! Vymazaný?
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Dokážeš si to představit? Já?! Vymazaný?

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: This all seems like a bureaucratic blunder.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Tohle všechno vypadá jako byrokratický omyl.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Tohle všechno vypadá jako byrokratický omyl.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: I'm surprised you didn't burn this place to the ground.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Divím se, že jsi tohle místo nespálil do základů.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Divím se, že jsi tohle místo nespálil do základů.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: That's precisely what I thought.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Přesně to jsem si myslel/a.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Přesně to jsem si myslel/a.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: When I protested, when I refused to go quietly to be erased, the Quill asked me to "take a number" for service.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Když jsem protestoval, když jsem odmítl tiše jít nechat se vymazat, Brk mě požádal, abych si „vzal číslo“ pro službu.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Když jsem protestoval, když jsem odmítl tiše jít nechat se vymazat, Brk mě požádal, abych si „vzal číslo“ pro službu.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: I've been waiting in this blasted place ever since.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Od té doby čekám v tomhle zatraceném místě.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Od té doby čekám v tomhle zatraceném místě.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: And I wait for no one!
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: A na nikoho nečekám!
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: A na nikoho nečekám!

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: I most certainly tried.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Rozhodně jsem se o to pokusil/a.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Rozhodně jsem se o to pokusil/a.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: My tormentors, it would seem.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Zdá se, že moji mučitelé.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Zdá se, že moji mučitelé.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: It's impossible to get a direct answer from any of them.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: It's impossible to get a direct answer from any of them.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: It's impossible to get a direct answer from any of them.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: They blather on about filling out section 4C of Form 2A. It's some infernal language I'm unfamiliar with.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: They blather on about filling out section 4C of Form 2A. It's some infernal language I'm unfamiliar with.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: They blather on about filling out section 4C of Form 2A. It's some infernal language I'm unfamiliar with.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: That's the language of bureaucracy.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: That's the language of bureaucracy.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: That's the language of bureaucracy.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: This place needs new management. Everything is so inefficient!
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: This place needs new management. Everything is so inefficient!
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: This place needs new management. Everything is so inefficient!

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: Whatever it is, it's beyond tedious. I'm tired of dealing with those fools.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Whatever it is, it's beyond tedious. I'm tired of dealing with those fools.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Whatever it is, it's beyond tedious. I'm tired of dealing with those fools.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: They practically make my goons look competent.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: They practically make my goons look competent.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: They practically make my goons look competent.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: I really ought to take it over and run it myself. But there's only so much one can do with poor servants.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: I really ought to take it over and run it myself. But there's only so much one can do with poor servants.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: I really ought to take it over and run it myself. But there's only so much one can do with poor servants.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: You think I haven't tried?
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: You think I haven't tried?
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: You think I haven't tried?

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: The moment I arrived, I tried to burn this place to cinders.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: The moment I arrived, I tried to burn this place to cinders.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: The moment I arrived, I tried to burn this place to cinders.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: But nothing happened.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: But nothing happened.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: But nothing happened.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: Must be the magic down here. It's blocking yours!
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Must be the magic down here. It's blocking yours!
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Must be the magic down here. It's blocking yours!

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: Maybe your magic is leaving you because you're being erased.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Maybe your magic is leaving you because you're being erased.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Maybe your magic is leaving you because you're being erased.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: So what you're saying is, you're helpless to do anything if I insult you?
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: So what you're saying is, you're helpless to do anything if I insult you?
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: So what you're saying is, you're helpless to do anything if I insult you?

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: I'm certain of it. There's sorcery in the air here, of a kind I've never encountered before.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: I'm certain of it. There's sorcery in the air here, of a kind I've never encountered before.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: I'm certain of it. There's sorcery in the air here, of a kind I've never encountered before.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: Every time I attempt magic, the atmosphere pushes back. It's curious.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Every time I attempt magic, the atmosphere pushes back. It's curious.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Every time I attempt magic, the atmosphere pushes back. It's curious.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: Perhaps. But it's more than that. There's sorcery in the air here, of a kind I've never encountered before.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Perhaps. But it's more than that. There's sorcery in the air here, of a kind I've never encountered before.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Perhaps. But it's more than that. There's sorcery in the air here, of a kind I've never encountered before.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: Helpless? Oh, I wouldn't say that.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Helpless? Oh, I wouldn't say that.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Helpless? Oh, I wouldn't say that.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: Go on. Insult me. Shall we see what happens?
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Go on. Insult me. Shall we see what happens?
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Go on. Insult me. Shall we see what happens?

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: I wouldn't dream of it.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: I wouldn't dream of it.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: I wouldn't dream of it.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: I was just being theoretical!
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: I was just being theoretical!
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: I was just being theoretical!

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: You're a mean, scary lady who's not very nice.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: You're a mean, scary lady who's not very nice.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: You're a mean, scary lady who's not very nice.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: Then you're wiser than you look.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Then you're wiser than you look.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Then you're wiser than you look.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: In any case, there is sorcery in the air here, of a kind I've never encountered before.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: In any case, there is sorcery in the air here, of a kind I've never encountered before.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: There's no one more reckless than a sniveling fool with a theory. Reminds me of Merlin.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: There's no one more reckless than a sniveling fool with a theory. Reminds me of Merlin.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: There's no one more reckless than a sniveling fool with a theory. Reminds me of Merlin.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: To be called cruel in a cruel world is hardly an insult.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: To be called cruel in a cruel world is hardly an insult.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: To be called cruel in a cruel world is hardly an insult.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: And it's best to be feared when those around you are too foolish to respect you.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: And it's best to be feared when those around you are too foolish to respect you.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: And it's best to be feared when those around you are too foolish to respect you.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: It's simple. These imbeciles won't listen to reason... or threats.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: <Lore>Talk to the Magic Quills</Lore> before I leave them in cinders.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: <Lore>Talk to the Magic Quills</Lore> before I leave them in cinders.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: <Lore>Talk to the Magic Quills</Lore> before I leave them in cinders.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: "Extra"? I haven't the faintest what you mean...
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: "Extra"? I haven't the faintest what you mean...
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: "Extra"? I haven't the faintest what you mean...

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: ...but it sounds suspiciously like an insult.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: ...but it sounds suspiciously like an insult.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: ...but it sounds suspiciously like an insult.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: And all who insult me soon rue their unwise choice.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: And all who insult me soon rue their unwise choice.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: And all who insult me soon rue their unwise choice.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: I totally meant it as a compliment!
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: I totally meant it as a compliment!
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: I totally meant it as a compliment!

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: Don't be so quick to threaten. Right now, you need my help.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Don't be so quick to threaten. Right now, you need my help.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Don't be so quick to threaten. Right now, you need my help.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: Uh, let's just start over. Hello, Maleficent!
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Uh, let's just start over. Hello, Maleficent!
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Uh, let's just start over. Hello, Maleficent!

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: Then choose your words more carefully. We wouldn't want to have a misunderstanding, would we?
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Then choose your words more carefully. We wouldn't want to have a misunderstanding, would we?
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Then choose your words more carefully. We wouldn't want to have a misunderstanding, would we?

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Hmm... You look familiar.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Hmm... You look familiar.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: Ahh. You're that brave fool who trespassed in my castle and lived to tell about it.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Ahh. You're that brave fool who trespassed in my castle and lived to tell about it.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Ahh. You're that brave fool who trespassed in my castle and lived to tell about it.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: Help? From you? Why would you ever think I needed help?
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Help? From you? Why would you ever think I needed help?
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Help? From you? Why would you ever think I needed help?

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: I will forgive your insolence this once. Next time, I will not be so lenient.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: I will forgive your insolence this once. Next time, I will not be so lenient.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: I will forgive your insolence this once. Next time, I will not be so lenient.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: Choose your words more carefully.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Choose your words more carefully.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Choose your words more carefully.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: Those Quills are ridiculous creatures.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Those Quills are ridiculous creatures.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Those Quills are ridiculous creatures.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: Imagine asking ME to wait for two eons?
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Imagine asking ME to wait for two eons?
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Imagine asking ME to wait for two eons?

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: The indignity!
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: The indignity!
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: The indignity!

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: Maybe there's a way to trick them into serving us sooner.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Maybe there's a way to trick them into serving us sooner.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Maybe there's a way to trick them into serving us sooner.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: They should at least put some reading material out or something.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: They should at least put some reading material out or something.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: They should at least put some reading material out or something.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: Only two eons? You got lucky. I need to wait five.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Only two eons? You got lucky. I need to wait five.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Only two eons? You got lucky. I need to wait five.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: My time is more valuable than any mortal's.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: My time is more valuable than any mortal's.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: My time is more valuable than any mortal's.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: Maybe I could <Lore>mess with the number counter</Lore> so our number comes up earlier.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Možná bych si mohl <Lore>pohrát s počítadlem čísel</Lore>, aby se naše číslo objevilo dříve.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Možná bych si mohl <Lore>pohrát s počítadlem čísel</Lore>, aby se naše číslo objevilo dříve.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: Yes, those creatures do seem feather-brained enough to fall for that.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Ano, ti tvorové se zdají být dost hloupí, aby tomu naletěli.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Ano, ti tvorové se zdají být dost hloupí, aby tomu naletěli.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: Perhaps you could <Lore>use my ticket</Lore> to speed things along.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Možná byste mohl/a <Lore>použít můj lístek</Lore>, abyste to urychlil/a.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Možná byste mohl/a <Lore>použít můj lístek</Lore>, abyste to urychlil/a.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: That might just work. Where is your ticket?
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: To by mohlo fungovat. Kde máš lístek?
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: To by mohlo fungovat. Kde máš lístek?

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: I tore it up in a fit of rage.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: V záchvatu vzteku jsem to roztrhal.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: V záchvatu vzteku jsem to roztrhal.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: *sigh* Why can't anything ever be simple?
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: *povzdech* Proč nic nemůže být nikdy jednoduché?
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: *povzdech* Proč nic nemůže být nikdy jednoduché?

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: I'm on it. I won't let you down!
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Jdu do toho. Nezklamu tě!
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Jdu do toho. Nezklamu tě!

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: Have you ever thought about getting a pillow to scream into?
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Přemýšleli jste někdy o tom, že byste si pořídili polštář, do kterého byste mohli křičet?
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Přemýšleli jste někdy o tom, že byste si pořídili polštář, do kterého byste mohli křičet?

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: You've proved to be clever before.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Už jsi jednou dokázal, že jsi chytrý.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Už jsi jednou dokázal, že jsi chytrý.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: I'm sure you can <Lore>find the pieces of my ticket scattered about</Lore>.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Jsem si jistý, že najdete kousky mého lístku rozházené všude kolem.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Jsem si jistý, že najdete kousky mého lístku rozházené všude kolem.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: Then you can <Lore>change the number counter to match it</Lore>.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Pak můžete <Lore>změnit počítadlo čísel tak, aby odpovídalo</Lore>.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Pak můžete <Lore>změnit počítadlo čísel tak, aby odpovídalo</Lore>.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: I'm beginning to like you. You're more clever and more obedient than my usual help.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Začínáš se mi líbit. Jsi chytřejší a poslušnější než moji obvyklí pomocníci.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Začínáš se mi líbit. Jsi chytřejší a poslušnější než moji obvyklí pomocníci.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: I wouldn't feel such rage if I weren't surrounded by fools and incompetents.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Necítil bych takový vztek, kdybych nebyl obklopen hlupáky a neschopnými lidmi.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Necítil bych takový vztek, kdybych nebyl obklopen hlupáky a neschopnými lidmi.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: But you... you have not let me down yet.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Ale ty... ty jsi mě ještě nezklamal/a.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Ale ty... ty jsi mě ještě nezklamal/a.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: That's not a completely foolish idea. But how would it be done?
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: To není úplně hloupý nápad. Ale jak by se to dalo udělat?
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: To není úplně hloupý nápad. Ale jak by se to dalo udělat?

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: In five billion years, you could read every word scribed by all mortal hands twice over. It's absurd!
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Za pět miliard let byste si mohli každé slovo napsané rukama všech smrtelníků přečíst dvakrát. To je absurdní!
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Za pět miliard let byste si mohli každé slovo napsané rukama všech smrtelníků přečíst dvakrát. To je absurdní!

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: Ahh... You've managed to rescue the second one.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Ááá... Podařilo se ti zachránit toho druhého.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Ááá... Podařilo se ti zachránit toho druhého.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: I feel stronger, more myself again.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Cítím se silnější, zase víc sama sebou.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Cítím se silnější, zase víc sama sebou.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: Have you managed to find a way forward yet? Time is of the essence. Or don't you see that I'm still fading away?
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Už se ti podařilo najít cestu vpřed? Čas je klíčový. Nebo nevidíš, že stále mizím?
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Už se ti podařilo najít cestu vpřed? Čas je klíčový. Nebo nevidíš, že stále mizím?

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: Have you found another piece of me yet? Time is of the essence.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Už jsi našel další kousek mě? Čas je klíčový.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Už jsi našel další kousek mě? Čas je klíčový.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: You found another missing piece? Bring it to me, quickly!
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Našel jsi další chybějící kousek? Přines mi ho, rychle!
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Našel jsi další chybějící kousek? Přines mi ho, rychle!

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: You found another missing piece? Bring it to me, quickly!
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Našel jsi další chybějící kousek? Přines mi ho, rychle!
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Našel jsi další chybějící kousek? Přines mi ho, rychle!

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: Give it to me. I wonder which moment from my life these fools saw fit to steal and destroy forever?
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Dej mi to. Zajímalo by mě, který okamžik z mého života tihle blázni uznali za vhodné ukrást a navždy zničit?
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Dej mi to. Zajímalo by mě, který okamžik z mého života tihle blázni uznali za vhodné ukrást a navždy zničit?

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: Maybe it's a happy moment, like enjoying some ice cream?
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Možná je to šťastný okamžik, jako když si člověk vychutnává zmrzlinu?
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Možná je to šťastný okamžik, jako když si člověk vychutnává zmrzlinu?

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: Maybe it's a sad moment. You ever have a rough breakup?
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Možná je to smutný okamžik. Zažil jsi někdy těžký rozchod?
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Možná je to smutný okamžik. Zažil jsi někdy těžký rozchod?

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: Maybe it's a boring, normal moment. Like doing your laundry.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Možná je to nudný, normální okamžik. Jako praní prádla.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Možná je to nudný, normální okamžik. Jako praní prádla.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: {PlayerName}, I've had precious few moments of pure happiness. How could I, when I'm surrounded by fools.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: {PlayerName}, zažil jsem jen málo vzácných okamžiků čistého štěstí. Jak bych mohl, když jsem obklopen blázny.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: {PlayerName}, zažil jsem jen málo vzácných okamžiků čistého štěstí. Jak bych mohl, když jsem obklopen blázny.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: No simple confection could bring me joy.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Žádná jednoduchá sladkost mi nemohla přinést radost.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Žádná jednoduchá sladkost mi nemohla přinést radost.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: But this... this does hold something bittersweet.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Ale tohle... tohle v sobě má něco hořkosladkého.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Ale tohle... tohle v sobě má něco hořkosladkého.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: It's the moment that I lured Aurora to the spinning wheel.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Je to ten okamžik, kdy jsem nalákal Auroru k kolovratu.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Je to ten okamžik, kdy jsem nalákal Auroru k kolovratu.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: It was my moment of greatest triumph.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: To byl můj okamžik největšího triumfu.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: To byl můj okamžik největšího triumfu.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: And the moment that sealed my fate.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: A okamžik, který zpečetil můj osud.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: A okamžik, který zpečetil můj osud.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: How is one to feel about a memory like that? How should I look upon the day that I achieved my vengeance over the entire royal family?
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Jak se má člověk cítit při takové vzpomínce? Jak bych se měl dívat na den, kdy jsem dosáhl své pomsty nad celou královskou rodinou?
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Jak se má člověk cítit při takové vzpomínce? Jak bych se měl dívat na den, kdy jsem dosáhl své pomsty nad celou královskou rodinou?

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: Hold on to how you felt in the moment. Villainy can be so sweet.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Drž se toho, jak jsi se v danou chvíli cítil/a. Zlomyslnost může být tak sladká.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Drž se toho, jak jsi se v danou chvíli cítil/a. Zlomyslnost může být tak sladká.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: Learn a lesson from it. Don't sacrifice everything over petty revenge.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Poučte se z toho. Neobětujte všechno kvůli malicherné pomstě.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Poučte se z toho. Neobětujte všechno kvůli malicherné pomstě.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: Ever think of apologizing to Aurora?
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Napadlo tě někdy omluvit se Auroře?
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Napadlo tě někdy omluvit se Auroře?

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: It certainly felt fulfilling. Regardless of later events, that day was a victory.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Rozhodně to byl naplňující pocit. Bez ohledu na pozdější události byl ten den vítězstvím.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Rozhodně to byl naplňující pocit. Bez ohledu na pozdější události byl ten den vítězstvím.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: And that victory tasted marvelous!
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: A to vítězství chutnalo skvěle!
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: A to vítězství chutnalo skvěle!

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: What's this? Oh, the magic of this place has begun to work.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Co to je? Ach, kouzlo tohoto místa začíná fungovat.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Co to je? Ach, kouzlo tohoto místa začíná fungovat.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: Ha-ha-ha-ha-ha! I am almost restored to my full power!
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Ha-ha-ha-ha-ha! Už jsem skoro zase v plné síle!
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Ha-ha-ha-ha-ha! Už jsem skoro zase v plné síle!

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: I'm not sure whether to celebrate or be very frightened.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Nejsem si jistý/á, jestli mám slavit, nebo se hodně bát.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Nejsem si jistý/á, jestli mám slavit, nebo se hodně bát.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: *cough cough* You're welcome.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: *kašel kašel* Není zač.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: *kašel kašel* Není zač.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: You're flourishing and I just wanna say, I love that for you!
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Daří se ti to a já chci jen říct, že to na tobě miluju!
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Daří se ti to a já chci jen říct, že to na tobě miluju!

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: You need not fear me, so long as you never slight me.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Nemusíš se mě bát, pokud mě nikdy nebudeš opovrhovat.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Nemusíš se mě bát, pokud mě nikdy nebudeš opovrhovat.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: You will be spared my wrath if you finish what has already begun.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Ušetříš se mého hněvu, pokud dokončíš, co už bylo započato.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Ušetříš se mého hněvu, pokud dokončíš, co už bylo započato.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: Right. You've still got one <ActivityItem>Anchor Moment</ActivityItem> I need to find.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Jasně. Pořád musím najít jeden <ActivityItem>Kotevní moment</ActivityItem>.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Jasně. Pořád musím najít jeden <ActivityItem>Kotevní moment</ActivityItem>.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: I'll be back in a jiffy!
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Hned jsem zpátky!
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Hned jsem zpátky!

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: I will reserve my gratitude until the task is complete.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Vděčnost si budu vyhrazovat do doby, než bude úkol dokončen.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Vděčnost si budu vyhrazovat do doby, než bude úkol dokončen.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: For now, while it remains unfinished, be thankful that you do not face my wrath.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Prozatím, dokud to není nedokončené, buď vděčný, že nečelíš mému hněvu.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Prozatím, dokud to není nedokončené, buď vděčný, že nečelíš mému hněvu.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: It's curious. You're different from other mortals...
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Je to zvláštní. Jsi jiný než ostatní smrtelníci...
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Je to zvláštní. Jsi jiný než ostatní smrtelníci...

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: You can be trusted to do something correctly the first time. You spare me kindness where others serve me slights.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Můžeš se spolehnout, že něco uděláš správně hned napoprvé. Ušetříš mi laskavosti tam, kde mi jiní dělají urážky.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Můžeš se spolehnout, že něco uděláš správně hned napoprvé. Ušetříš mi laskavosti tam, kde mi jiní dělají urážky.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: Yes, I'm rather starting to like you.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Ano, začínáš se mi docela líbit.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Ano, začínáš se mi docela líbit.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: Oh! Uh... back at you!
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Ach! Ehm... zpátky k tobě!
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Ach! Ehm... zpátky k tobě!

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: Game recognizes game.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Hra rozpoznává hru.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Hra rozpoznává hru.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: Maleficent and {PlayerName} slumber party when?!
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Zloba a {PlayerName} pyžamová párty kdy?!
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Zloba a {PlayerName} pyžamová párty kdy?!

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: Let us not become complacent.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Nebuďme spokojení.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Nebuďme spokojení.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: We must finish what is already begun.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Musíme dokončit, co už bylo započato.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Musíme dokončit, co už bylo započato.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: You mortals can certainly turn a phrase.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Vy smrtelníci jistě umíte obrátit frázi.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Vy smrtelníci jistě umíte obrátit frázi.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: I shall have no time for slumber until we finish what we've begun.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Nebudu mít čas na spánek, dokud nedokončíme, co jsme začali.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Nebudu mít čas na spánek, dokud nedokončíme, co jsme začali.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: Oh, I most certainly learned something.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Aha, určitě jsem se něco naučil.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Aha, určitě jsem se něco naučil.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: Leave no loose ends. I ought to have sent Prince Phillip off to an eternal slumber just as I did Aurora.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Nenechávej žádné nedodělky. Měla jsem poslat prince Filipa k věčnému spánku, stejně jako jsem poslala Auroru.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Nenechávej žádné nedodělky. Měla jsem poslat prince Filipa k věčnému spánku, stejně jako jsem poslala Auroru.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: Apologizing? Whatever for?
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Omlouváš se? Za cokoliv?
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Omlouváš se? Za cokoliv?

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: That whole wretched royal clan ought to apologize to me for their slights.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Celý ten ubohý královský klan by se mi měl omluvit za své urážky.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Celý ten ubohý královský klan by se mi měl omluvit za své urážky.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: When I think of that day, I have only one regret...
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Když si na ten den vzpomenu, lituji jen jednoho...
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Když si na ten den vzpomenu, lituji jen jednoho...

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: ...that I didn't send Prince Phillip to the same eternal slumber as Aurora.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: ...že jsem neposlal prince Filipa do stejného věčného spánku jako Auroru.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: ...že jsem neposlal prince Filipa do stejného věčného spánku jako Auroru.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: My life has had its share of miseries. After all, I'm surrounded by fools.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Můj život si už užil spoustu utrpení. Koneckonců, jsem obklopen blázny.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Můj život si už užil spoustu utrpení. Koneckonců, jsem obklopen blázny.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: But this holds something more bittersweet...
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Ale tohle v sobě skrývá něco hořkosladšího...
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Ale tohle v sobě skrývá něco hořkosladšího...

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: ... Wait. Do you do laundry?
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: ... Počkej. Pereš prádlo?
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: ... Počkej. Pereš prádlo?

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: Don't be foolish. This is sure to hold a turning point in my life. Something of importance. Not something mundane.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Nebuď hloupý. Tohle bude jistě zlomový bod v mém životě. Něco důležitého. Ne něco všedního.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Nebuď hloupý. Tohle bude jistě zlomový bod v mém životě. Něco důležitého. Ne něco všedního.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: You must find the other parts of me that they're trying to erase.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Musíš najít ty další části mě, které se snaží vymazat.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Musíš najít ty další části mě, které se snaží vymazat.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: Go speak to the other nuisance Quill at once!
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Okamžitě si promluvte s tím druhým otravným Quillem!
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Okamžitě si promluvte s tím druhým otravným Quillem!

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: That nuisance feather gave you a wheel? Well, pick it up and figure out where it goes!
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: To otravné pírko ti dalo kolo? Tak ho zvedni a zjisti, kam to vede!
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: To otravné pírko ti dalo kolo? Tak ho zvedni a zjisti, kam to vede!

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: Finally, someone who isn't an UTTER fool.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Konečně někdo, kdo není ÚPLNÝ hlupák.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Konečně někdo, kdo není ÚPLNÝ hlupák.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: Have you found the final moment they stole from me? I'll take it now.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Našel jsi ten poslední okamžik, který mi ukradli? Vezmu si ho hned.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Našel jsi ten poslední okamžik, který mi ukradli? Vezmu si ho hned.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: I'm afraid we have just a tiny little wrinkle.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Obávám se, že máme jen malou vrásku.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Obávám se, že máme jen malou vrásku.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: The Lorekeeper told me you're the cause of all the problems. You need to be erased.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Strážce Vědomostí mi řekl, že jsi příčinou všech problémů. Musíš být vymazán.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Strážce Vědomostí mi řekl, že jsi příčinou všech problémů. Musíš být vymazán.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: And what might that be?
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: A co by to mohlo být?
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: A co by to mohlo být?

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: The Lorekeeper told me you're the cause of all the problems. You need to be erased.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Strážce Vědomostí mi řekl, že jsi příčinou všech problémů. Musíš být vymazán.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Strážce Vědomostí mi řekl, že jsi příčinou všech problémů. Musíš být vymazán.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: How absurd!
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Jak absurdní!
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Jak absurdní!

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: That tattered tome has no idea what she's talking about or who she's challenging.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Ta potrhaná kniha nemá ponětí, o čem mluví nebo koho vyzývá.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Ta potrhaná kniha nemá ponětí, o čem mluví nebo koho vyzývá.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: I shall tear every last yellowed page from her cracked spine, one by one!
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Vytrhnu jí z popraskaného hřbetu každou zažloutlou stránku, jednu po druhé!
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Vytrhnu jí z popraskaného hřbetu každou zažloutlou stránku, jednu po druhé!

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: This has to all be a big mistake.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Tohle všechno musí být velká chyba.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Tohle všechno musí být velká chyba.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: Hey, now. Damaging books is NOT cool.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Hele, teď. Poškozování knih NENÍ cool.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Hele, teď. Poškozování knih NENÍ cool.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: You're not exactly proving her wrong right now.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Teď jí zrovna nedokážeš, že se mýlí.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Teď jí zrovna nedokážeš, že se mýlí.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: Mistake? No. I smell treachery. This is pure deceit.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Chyba? Ne. Cítím zradu. Tohle je čirý podvod.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Chyba? Ne. Cítím zradu. Tohle je čirý podvod.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: You of all mortals know that I'm more than just some petty villain.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Zrovna ty ze všech smrtelníků víš, že jsem víc než jen nějaký malicherný padouch.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Zrovna ty ze všech smrtelníků víš, že jsem víc než jen nějaký malicherný padouch.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: You've seen me scorned and betrayed.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Viděl jsi mě opovrhovaného a zrazeného.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Viděl jsi mě opovrhovaného a zrazeného.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: You've seen me at my moment of greatest triumph.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Viděl jsi mě v okamžiku mého největšího triumfu.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Viděl jsi mě v okamžiku mého největšího triumfu.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: And in your hands, I'm certain my fate can be changed.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: A ve tvých rukou se můj osud jistě může změnit.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: A ve tvých rukou se můj osud jistě může změnit.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: Don't do that foul book's bidding. She's lying. Something's not right.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Nedělej, co ta hnusná kniha káže. Lže. Něco není v pořádku.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Nedělej, co ta hnusná kniha káže. Lže. Něco není v pořádku.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: I won't erase you. Here. Take your last Anchor Moment back.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Nevymažu tě. Tady. Vezmi si zpátky svůj poslední Kotvící okamžik.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Nevymažu tě. Tady. Vezmi si zpátky svůj poslední Kotvící okamžik.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: I'm sorry, Maleficent. The Lorekeeper says you need to be erased.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Je mi líto, Zlobe. Věštkyně říká, že musíš být vymazána.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Je mi líto, Zlobe. Věštkyně říká, že musíš být vymazána.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: I don't know! I'm not good at high-stakes decisions!!!
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Nevím! Nejsem dobrý v riskantních rozhodnutích!!!
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Nevím! Nejsem dobrý v riskantních rozhodnutích!!!

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: You have not failed me, {PlayerName}. Only you would not fall for a lie about me.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Nezklamal jsi mě, {PlayerName}. Jen bys nenaletěl na lež o mně.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Nezklamal jsi mě, {PlayerName}. Jen bys nenaletěl na lež o mně.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: Ahh... This page contains the day that Phillip raised his sword against me.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Ááá... Tato stránka obsahuje den, kdy Phillip proti mně pozvedl meč.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Ááá... Tato stránka obsahuje den, kdy Phillip proti mně pozvedl meč.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: My fate was nothing but foul luck. Had that insipid Flora not interfered, I'd have struck him down.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Můj osud byl jen smůla. Kdyby se do toho nevměšovala ta mdlá Flora, srazil bych ho k zemi.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Můj osud byl jen smůla. Kdyby se do toho nevměšovala ta mdlá Flora, srazil bych ho k zemi.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: I definitely wouldn't want to go up against you as a dragon.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Rozhodně bych se proti tobě nechtěl postavit jako drak.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Rozhodně bych se proti tobě nechtěl postavit jako drak.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: You keep telling yourself that.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: To si pořád říkáš.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: To si pořád říkáš.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: Can you turn into a dragon and offer rides to people in the Valley?
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Můžeš se proměnit v draka a nabízet svezení lidem v Údolí?
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Můžeš se proměnit v draka a nabízet svezení lidem v Údolí?

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: Then you are less a fool than Phillip, at least.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.cz: Pak jsi alespoň menší hlupák než Phillip.
Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Pak jsi alespoň menší hlupák než Phillip.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: Ah! It seems the magic of this page is beginning to take hold.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Navštívíme Věštce?

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Dej mi ten okamžik, který mi byl ukraden, nebo ti ho vyrvu z rukou!

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: *polknutí* Hi. Tady to máš.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: Then allow me to make this choice for you.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Pak mi dovolte, abych tuto volbu učinil za vás.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.en: Give me the ending of my story, or I shall pry it from your hands.

Expansion02Part2_Maleficent/Maleficent_M.original_cz: Řekni mi konec mého příběhu, nebo ti ho vyrvu z rukou.
